story.title: Resignations at Reform UK Amid Allegations of Foreign Funding Scandal
story.summary: Two senior officials from the Reform UK party stepped down following an undercover investigation that allegedly revealed discussions about soliciting foreign funding for party activities, which is illegal under UK law. The investigation suggested a potential £500,000 donation from a US donor. Reform UK has denied any wrongdoing, claiming it was a victim of a hoax.

related_stories.title: U.S. Military Destroys Three Iranian Oil Tankers Following Attacks
related_stories.summary: The U.S. military reported that it destroyed three Iranian oil tankers, including the M/T Downy and M/T Stark 1, after Iran launched ballistic missile attacks targeting U.S. naval vessels. The U.S. Central Command stated that the attacks on the tankers were a response to Iran's failed missile strikes against a U.S. aircraft carrier and a destroyer.

related_stories.summary: Masked protesters chanting 'stop the boats' blocked major roads leading to the Port of Dover, disrupting traffic at the UK's busiest international ferry port. The demonstration briefly halted access to the port, prompting condemnation from the UK government.

related_stories.title: US Ambassador Visits Palestinian Town Affected by Settler Violence
related_stories.summary: US Ambassador to Israel Mike Huckabee visited the Palestinian town of Turmus Ayya in the Israeli-occupied West Bank, which has faced repeated violence from Israeli settlers. During his visit, Huckabee emphasized the need for the Israeli government to address the issue of violent settlers.

related_stories.title: Escalating Ground Fighting in Yemen Results in Over 60 Deaths, Including Civilians
related_stories.summary: Clashes between Yemen's Saudi-backed government forces and Houthi rebels have resulted in at least 60 fatalities, including civilians. The fighting, which is among the deadliest in recent years, occurred during a Houthi offensive on the western coast. Additionally, a missile strike by the Houthis near Taiz killed at least four civilians amid ongoing violence and displacement in the region.
